name: Each load readout is fully readable

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Verify the EV charger row shows a power figure reading '7.0 kW' in full — the unit and decimal place must both be visible, not cut off.
Verify the same row shows a slot count sub-label reading '7 slots' in full.
Verify all three controls ('-', '+' and 'x') are visible in the same row, each fully inside the row and not overlapping the text.
Verify the energy figure reading '12 kWh' and the sub-label 'by slot 95' are both visible in the same row.
Verify no two of the four items overlap: the label, the two figures, and the controls.
